helper:
Private Function Listed(wb As Object) As String
    Dim n As Object, out As String
    For Each n In wb.Names
        out = out & n.Name & "=" & n.RefersTo & "|" & n.RefersToR1C1 & "|" & n.Visible & ";"
    Next
    Listed = out
End Function
build:
Private Function Listed(wb As Object) As String
    Dim n As Object, out As String
    For Each n In wb.Names
        out = out & n.Name & "=" & n.RefersTo & "|" & n.RefersToR1C1 & "|" & n.Visible & ";"
    Next
    Listed = out
End Function
Private Function Make0(folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Object, ws As Object, notes As String, out As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Name = "Data"
    wb.Worksheets.Add After:=ws
    wb.Worksheets(2).Name = "Other"
    ws.Range("A1").Value = "Qty"
    ws.Range("B1").Value = "Price"
    ws.Range("A2:B3").Value = 1
    ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B3"), , xlYes).Name = "Sales"
    wb.Worksheets("Data").Activate
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    wb.Names.Add "N_column", "=Sales[Qty]"
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then notes = notes & "E" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description & " "
    On Error GoTo 0
    out = "refers_column_on_table_sheet{{name}}" & notes & "{{names}}" & Listed(wb) & "{{reopened}}"
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\refers_column_on_table_sheet.xlsx", 51
    wb.Close False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\refers_column_on_table_sheet.xlsx")
    out = out & Listed(wb)
    wb.Close False
    Make0 = out & "{{case}}"
End Function
